name: Bhama Arun
bio: Bhama Arun is an Indian film Actress who has worked predominantly in Malayalam movie industry.

credits.title: Athimanoharam
credits.overview: Sub-Inspector T. S. Lovelajan and his family navigate the grueling psychological toll of law enforcement as demanding professional duties directly clash with domestic life.

credits.title: Bazooka
credits.overview: A cop and a businessman team up on a mission to capture a serial killer, using a series of elaborate games to track him down.

credits.title: Rekhachithram
credits.overview: Having recently served a suspension for gambling online while on duty, Circle Inspector Vivek Gopinath rejoins the police force and is looking to reclaim his lost honour. Awaiting him is a 40-year-old, unresolved murder mystery with a faceless victim.

credits.title: Arjuna Phalguna
credits.overview: Arjun, an unemployed youngster, with his friends plan to start a soda factory, but a lack of money hinders their plans. By taking smuggling route, they agree to transport Ganja as a quick route to earn money and land in a mess. A cat and mouse game between the police and the friends begin.

credits.title: Childhood Friends
credits.overview: A group of friends visit Goa for a holiday trip during their college break. Their lives take a deadly turn when they cross paths with a couple at a local bar and get dragged into a world of drugs.

credits.title: School Diary
credits.overview: A group of friends including five girls and four boys studying in 12th standard share a close bond with each other. All goes well for the group until suddenly a crisis arises, which puts their friendship to test.
